The Queen Elizabeth II Cup, where three 
sisters fought in serious competition.

In the heat of the race, Cheval Grand 
found herself in a frame of mind where she 
could appreciate the differences and 
unique strengths of all three sisters, 
including herself.

In the photo taken of the three sisters 
after the race, though one could hardly 
say they looked alike, each of them shone 
with their own uniquely beautiful smile.
